1. For the right-hand limit \(\lim_{x\to 2^+}f(x)\), look at the graph for \(x\)-values slightly greater than \(2\).
2. Just to the right of \(x=2\), the graph follows the decreasing line that begins at the open circle \((2,4)\).
3. As \(x\) approaches \(2\) from the right, the \(y\)-values approach \(4\). The open circle means \(f(2)\) is not \(4\), but the limit still approaches \(4\).

\[
\boxed{\lim_{x\to 2^+} f(x)=4}
\]
